description: Surgically edit a section of a note — targeted by heading or block reference — without rewriting the whole file. Operations: append (add after section), prepend (add after heading line), replace (swap section content). Frontmatter is never touched.

content.description: Content to insert or replace with.

createIfMissing.description: If the heading target is not found, append a new heading (level 2) + content. Only valid for heading targets. Default false.

operation.description: append: insert after section content. prepend: insert after heading line. replace: swap section content.

prevHash.description: Optional compare-and-swap guard: the contentHash from a prior read. Fails with hash_conflict if the note changed since.

target.description: Exactly one of: { heading: "Section Title" } or { block: "block-id" } (without the ^ prefix).

name: patch_note
